scope: Archived result.metrics storage counters for the frozen joint-kv full run.

snapshot_tag_count.meaning: The storage counter received no lifecycle Tag UID input. Real MEMORY recovery counts are measured separately by resumes and request continuity.

snapshot_write_bytes.meaning: Whole-trial physical snapshot bytes were uncollected.

peak_storage_bytes.meaning: Whole-trial trial-attributed physical peak storage bytes were uncollected.

snapshot_write_amplification.meaning: The ratio requires whole-trial physical writes and an explicitly measured logical baseline; these observations were uncollected.

snapshot_logical_upload_records.meaning: Zero counts uploader log records observed by this metric collector. Recovery and physical storage write volume have separate evidence.

snapshot_logical_upload_bytes_observed.meaning: Zero is the sum of the empty observed uploader log sample; upload-log byte coverage is uncollected.

physical_storage_coverage_fraction.meaning: The collector supplied zero whole-trial physical storage coverage.
